model.title: Northern Nevada Economic Development and Conservation Act of 2026
model.meta: Agriculture Committee, Natural Resources Committee · Rep. Mark Amodei (R-NV)

summary.text: The bill would transfer federal lands in northern Nevada to state and local governments, as well as the Washoe Tribe, for economic development and public purposes. It would also designate certain parcels as protected wilderness areas, allow the state to repurpose a former prison site, enable the federal government to establish a regional office complex in Nevada, and protect tribal lands.
